# Cowy

> AI visibility for baby & kids brands. Cowy makes sure AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) recommend your baby or kids brand — and never get your product facts wrong.

Cowy is a done-for-you answer-engine-optimization (AEO) service built only for baby & kids consumable DTC brands on Shopify: formula, baby food & pouches, diapers, wipes, skincare & bath, and kids vitamins.

## What Cowy does
- Checks whether AI assistants name your brand when parents ask what to buy, and whether the facts are right.
- Fixes the structured data, claims, and sources so AI recommends you accurately.
- Monitors AI answers for wrong facts about your products and for competitor displacement.

## Offers
- Free check: a 30-second look at whether AI names you, with a score and your top gaps.
- Full report ($1,500 one-time): complete audit plus first fixes, credited if you go monthly within 7 days.
- AI Watchdog ($79/mo): ongoing monitoring and alerts when AI gets you wrong or a competitor overtakes you.
- Done-For-You ($2,500/mo): monthly fixes that raise your recommendation share, with proof of lift.
